description: This file defines an abstract class 'AbstractTwigCallable' which is part of the Twig templating engine. The class implements a callable interface for Twig functions or filters, managing options, deprecation info, and callable properties. It provides foundational functionality for defining custom Twig callables, including handling deprecations, arguments, and environment requirements.

classes.name: AbstractTwigCallable
classes.description: Abstract class providing base functionality for Twig callable objects, managing options, deprecations, and invocation details.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the callable with name, callable, and options, handling deprecation options.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the callable object.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the callable.

methods.name: getDynamicName
methods.description: Returns the dynamic name of the callable.

methods.name: getNodeClass
methods.description: Returns the node class associated with the callable.

methods.name: needsCharset
methods.description: Checks if the callable needs charset information.

methods.name: needsEnvironment
methods.description: Checks if the callable needs the Twig environment.

methods.name: needsContext
methods.description: Checks if the callable needs the context.

methods.name: withDynamicArguments
methods.description: Creates a clone of the callable with specified dynamic arguments.

methods.name: setArguments
methods.description: Deprecated method to set arguments; use withDynamicArguments() instead.

methods.name: getArguments
methods.description: Returns the current list of arguments.

methods.name: isVariadic
methods.description: Checks if the callable accepts variadic arguments.

methods.name: isDeprecated
methods.description: Checks if the callable is marked as deprecated.

methods.name: triggerDeprecation
methods.description: Triggers a deprecation warning related to this callable.

methods.name: getDeprecatingPackage
methods.description: Deprecated: Returns the name of the package that deprecated the callable.

methods.name: getDeprecatedVersion
methods.description: Deprecated: Returns the version when the callable was deprecated.

methods.name: getAlternative
methods.description: Deprecated: Returns an alternative suggestion for the callable.

methods.name: getMinimalNumberOfRequiredArguments
methods.description: Calculates and returns the minimum number of required arguments for this callable.
